content.content:
# File Content Analysis

This TypeScript/Next.js server action file manages Discord generation roles through a Supabase database and external API integration.

## Key Functions

**checkAdmin()**: Verifies user authentication and administrator status by querying the members table before allowing privileged operations.

**callCreateGenerationApi()**: Makes authenticated POST requests to an external STEM Bot API endpoint to create Discord roles, requiring both API URL and bearer token environment variables.

**ensureGenerationRoleExists()**: Non-blocking function that creates a generation role if it doesn't exist in the database, catching errors gracefully since concurrent processes might create duplicates.

**createGenerationRole()**: Admin-only function that checks for existing roles, calls the creation API, and handles duplicate prevention with appropriate error messaging in Japanese.

**updateGenerationRoles()**: Admin-only function that performs a complete replacement of all generation roles using delete-then-insert logic rather than upsert operations, with validation filtering.

## Security Observations

- Admin privileges checked via `checkAdmin()` function
- Uses Supabase client for standard operations and admin client for sensitive bulk updates
- Environment variables store sensitive API credentials
- Cache disabled on external API calls

---
title: "checkAdmin (stem-system: generations.ts)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_create_client: supabase = await createClient()
    q_create_client --> q_get_user: user = await supabase.auth.getUser()
    q_get_user --> q_check_auth: user exists?
    q_check_auth --> q_error_auth: !user
    q_check_auth --> q_query_admin: user exists
    q_error_auth --> [*]: throw Error("Authentication required.")
    q_query_admin --> q_check_admin: admin = await supabase.from("members").select("is_admin").eq("supabase_auth_user_id", user.id).single()
    q_check_admin --> q_error_admin: !admin?.is_admin
    q_check_admin --> [*]: admin.is_admin === true
    q_error_admin --> [*]: throw Error("Administrator privileges required.")

    note right of q_check_auth
        INV-001: user is non-null after this guard passes
    end note

    note right of q_check_admin
        INV-002: Only users with is_admin=true in members table pass this point
        INV-003: Authorization depends on supabase_auth_user_id matching the authenticated user
    end note

---
title: "callCreateGenerationApi (stem-system: generations.ts)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_read_env: apiUrl = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_STEM_BOT_API_URL; token = process.env.STEM_BOT_API_BEARER_TOKEN
    q_read_env --> q_check_env: apiUrl and token defined?
    q_check_env --> q_error_env: !apiUrl || !token
    q_check_env --> q_fetch: apiUrl and token present
    q_error_env --> [*]: throw Error("API URL or Bearer Token is not configured.")
    q_fetch --> q_parse: response = await fetch(apiUrl + "/api/generation", POST, Bearer token, JSON body)
    q_parse --> q_check_response: result = await response.json()
    q_check_response --> q_error_api: !response.ok || !result.success
    q_check_response --> [*]: response.ok and result.success; return GenerationRole
    q_error_api --> [*]: throw Error(result.error || "Discord role creation failed")

    note right of q_read_env
        INV-001: NEXT_PUBLIC_STEM_BOT_API_URL is client-exposed env var (potential info leak)
        INV-002: STEM_BOT_API_BEARER_TOKEN must remain server-side only
    end note

    note right of q_fetch
        INV-003: Request includes Bearer token in Authorization header
        INV-004: cache set to no-store to prevent credential caching
        INV-005: generation parameter is passed directly to API without range validation
    end note

---
title: "ensureGenerationRoleExists (stem-system: generations.ts)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_create_client: supabase = await createClient()
    q_create_client --> q_query: existingRole = await supabase.from("generation_roles").select("generation").eq("generation", generation).single()
    q_query --> q_check_exists: existingRole found?
    q_check_exists --> [*]: existingRole exists (no-op)
    q_check_exists --> q_try_create: !existingRole
    q_try_create --> q_call_api: await callCreateGenerationApi(generation)
    q_call_api --> q_revalidate: API success
    q_call_api --> q_catch: API throws error
    q_revalidate --> [*]: revalidatePath("/dashboard/admin/generations")
    q_catch --> [*]: console.error(error); swallow exception

    note right of q_check_exists
        INV-001: No admin check performed - any authenticated user can trigger this
        INV-002: Race condition possible - concurrent calls may both see !existingRole
    end note

    note right of q_catch
        INV-003: Errors are silently swallowed - failure is not propagated to caller
        INV-004: Duplicate creation errors from concurrent processes are expected and tolerated
    end note

---
title: "createGenerationRole (stem-system: generations.ts)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_admin: await checkAdmin()
    q_admin --> q_error_auth: throws (not admin)
    q_admin --> q_create_client: admin check passed
    q_error_auth --> [*]: return error message, newRole=null
    q_create_client --> q_query: supabase = await createClient(); query generation_roles for generation
    q_query --> q_check_db_error: check existingError
    q_check_db_error --> q_throw_db: existingError and code !== "PGRST116"
    q_check_db_error --> q_check_exists: no error or PGRST116 (not found)
    q_throw_db --> q_catch: throw existingError
    q_check_exists --> q_duplicate: existingRole found
    q_check_exists --> q_call_api: !existingRole
    q_duplicate --> [*]: return error="generation N already exists", newRole=null
    q_call_api --> q_success: newRole = await callCreateGenerationApi(generation)
    q_call_api --> q_catch: API throws error
    q_success --> [*]: revalidatePath; return error=null, newRole
    q_catch --> [*]: console.error; return error=e.message, newRole=null

    note right of q_admin
        INV-001: Admin authorization enforced before any database operation
    end note

    note right of q_check_db_error
        INV-002: PGRST116 (no rows found) is treated as non-error condition
        INV-003: All other Supabase errors are re-thrown
    end note

    note right of q_check_exists
        INV-004: Duplicate check is not atomic with creation (TOCTOU race possible)
        INV-005: generation parameter not validated for range or type before DB query
    end note

---
title: "updateGenerationRoles (stem-system: generations.ts)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_admin: await checkAdmin()
    q_admin --> q_error_auth: throws (not admin)
    q_admin --> q_get_admin_client: admin check passed
    q_error_auth --> [*]: return error=e.message
    q_get_admin_client --> q_delete: supabaseAdmin = await createAdminClient(); delete all from generation_roles where generation != -1
    q_delete --> q_check_delete: deleteError?
    q_check_delete --> q_throw_delete: deleteError present
    q_check_delete --> q_filter: delete succeeded
    q_throw_delete --> q_catch: throw deleteError
    q_filter --> q_check_valid: validRoles = roles.filter(r => r.generation >= 0 and discord_role_id not empty)
    q_check_valid --> q_insert: validRoles.length > 0
    q_check_valid --> q_revalidate: validRoles.length === 0 (skip insert)
    q_insert --> q_check_insert: insertError?
    q_check_insert --> q_throw_insert: insertError present
    q_check_insert --> q_revalidate: insert succeeded
    q_throw_insert --> q_catch: throw insertError
    q_revalidate --> [*]: revalidatePath; return error=null
    q_catch --> [*]: return error=e.message

    note right of q_delete
        INV-001: Uses admin client (bypasses RLS) for bulk delete
        INV-002: Delete condition neq("generation", -1) deletes ALL rows (no row has generation=-1 normally)
        INV-003: Delete and insert are NOT atomic - failure after delete loses all roles
    end note

    note right of q_filter
        INV-004: Validation only checks generation >= 0 and non-empty discord_role_id
        INV-005: discord_role_id is not validated as a valid Discord snowflake ID
        INV-006: No limit on number of roles that can be inserted
    end note

    note right of q_get_admin_client
        INV-007: Admin client bypasses Row Level Security - privilege escalation vector if checkAdmin is bypassed
    end note
